MPCONFIGSYNC-ENABLED.title: Enable MP config sync
MPCONFIGSYNC-ENABLED.hover.desc: Master switch for both directions, default ON. As host: push all local mod config values to every peer at multiplayer run start (and on rejoin). As peer: accept the host's values. Both ends must enable it. Turning it OFF mid-session stops sending and ignores further snapshots immediately. If it was OFF when the process started, the send/receive consumer patch classes were not registered, so turning it back ON needs a game restart; one resident receive guard remains by design to block BaseLib's external handler and performs no synchronization. Host values are applied in memory for the current session only - your cfg files are never rewritten - and your own values are restored when the run ends.
MPCONFIGSYNC-ENABLE_SENDING.title: Send config snapshots
MPCONFIGSYNC-ENABLE_SENDING.hover.desc: Sending group switch, requires the master switch too, default ON. As host: push the config snapshot at multiplayer run start and on rejoin. Turning it OFF mid-session stops further sends immediately. If it was OFF when the process started, the send consumer patch classes and the send guard are not registered for this process, so turning it back ON needs a game restart. If the send guard cannot be installed or verified, sending fails closed for this process (no snapshot is sent) instead of falling back to the master-switch-only path.
MPCONFIGSYNC-ENABLE_RECEIVING.title: Receive config snapshots
MPCONFIGSYNC-ENABLE_RECEIVING.hover.desc: Receiving group switch, requires the master switch too, default ON. As peer: accept the host's config values in memory for this session, and your own values are restored when the run ends. Turning it OFF mid-session ignores further snapshots immediately. If it was OFF when the process started, the receive consumer patch classes were not registered, so turning it back ON needs a game restart; the resident receive guard remains only to block BaseLib's external handler and performs no synchronization. If the receive guard cannot be installed or verified, the receive direction is hard-blocked for this process (every host snapshot is rejected) instead of falling back to the master-switch-only path.
